modules.name: Sequencer
modules.description: The OP-Z's front panel and master: eight tracks of 16 steps with micro timing, step components, live and step recording, a mixer and ten project slots

modules.name: Drum
modules.description: The OP-Z's drum tracks: a 24-sound kit per track, synthesized or loaded from OP-1 and OP-Z kits, AIFF and WAV files, with the drum note styles

modules.name: Digital
modules.description: The OP-Z's raw digital FM engine on a full synth track: filter, envelope, LFO, note styles and portamento

modules.name: Analog
modules.description: The OP-Z's subtractive engine, saw, sub and noise through an enveloped low-pass, on a full synth track

modules.name: Cluster
modules.description: The OP-Z's clustered oscillators, seven detuned saws per note, on a full synth track

modules.name: Organ
modules.description: The OP-Z's FM organ, eight algorithms from drawbars to reeds and bells, on a full synth track

modules.name: Breakout
modules.description: An OP-Z synth track for a voice made of other modules: pitch, gate, envelope, LFO and dials out, the sound back in through its filter and envelope

modules.name: Drum Breakout
modules.description: An OP-Z drum track for sounds made of other modules: trigger, gate, sound, velocity, envelope, LFO and dials out, the sound back in through its filter and envelope

modules.name: Screen
modules.description: The OP-Z's phone app as an expander: place it to the right of an OP-Z engine to see its pages, its sound and every dial, and to edit them by touch
